question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT q1.cust_city
    FROM city_sales q1
    JOIN city_sales q2 ON q1.cust_city = q2.cust_city
    WHERE q1.calendar_year = 2019 AND q2.calendar_year = 2020
      AND q1.total_sales > 0
      AND 1.0 * (q2.total_sales - q1.total_sales) / q1.total_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_total_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
product_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        total_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as tile
    FROM product_total_sales
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM product_ranked
    WHERE tile = 1
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cps.prod_id,
        cps.calendar_year,
        SUM(cps.product_sales) as product_quarter_sales
    FROM city_product_sales cps
    WHERE cps.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
    GROUP BY cps.prod_id, cps.calendar_year
),
total_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(product_sales) as total_quarter_sales
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_year
),
product_share AS (
    SELECT 
        pq.prod_id,
        pq.calendar_year,
        pq.product_quarter_sales,
        tq.total_quarter_sales,
        1.0 * pq.product_quarter_sales / tq.total_quarter_sales as share
    FROM product_quarter_sales pq
    JOIN total_quarter_sales tq ON pq.calendar_year = tq.calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    ps1.prod_id,
    p.prod_name,
    ROUND(ps1.share, 6) as share_2019,
    ROUND(ps2.share, 6) as share_2020,
    ROUND(ps2.share - ps1.share, 6) as share_change
FROM product_share ps1
JOIN product_share ps2 ON ps1.prod_id = ps2.prod_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON ps1.prod_id = p.prod_id
WHERE ps1.calendar_year = 2019 AND ps2.calendar_year = 2020
ORDER BY share_change DESC
